name: double-pause-pull-up
instructions:
1. Using a pronated grip, grasp the pull up bar with a slightly wider than shoulder width grip.
2. Take a deep breath, squeeze your glutes and brace your abs. Depress the shoulder blades and then drive the elbows straight down to the floor while activating the lats.
3. Pull your chin towards the bar until the lats are fully contracted, pause, then slowly lower yourself halfway down, pause, then continue to lower yourself back to the start position and repeat for the assigned number of repetitions.
